_doc: Ronde 18 — project-scoped MCP config for djinlabs_system_design. Loaded by MCP clients that walk up from cwd looking for .mcp.json. Secrets live in .gg/.env (gitignored, mode 0600); this file references a wrapper that sources it. Never embed tokens here. Path in `command` resolves relative to this file's directory.

notion._doc: Official Notion MCP server (npm: @notionhq/notion-mcp-server). Bearer auth is the only auth path Notion supports for personal/internal integrations; OAuth is reserved for public connections.
